Cyclone Marasu Update: Severe cyclonic storm Murasu began its landfall process close to Ongole in Prakasam district in the early hours of Tuesday. The cyclone is currently over Westcentral Bay of Bengal close to south Andhra Pradesh coast and moving north-northwestwards. It is likely to move North-northwestwards and weaken gradually into a cyclonic storm by noon and further into a deep depression by Tuesday midnight.
